dslRule:
<!id: java.lang.String.equals.nullsafe>
<!description: Replace potentially null-unsafe `variable.equals(literal)` with null-safe `literal.equals(variable)` for String comparisons when the variable may be null.>
<!severity: HINT>

$var.equals($literal) :: instanceof($var, "java.lang.String") && isStringLiteral($literal) && isNullable($var)
=>
$literal.equals($var)
;;
summary: Replaces `variable.equals("literal")` with `"literal".equals(variable)` for String comparisons when `variable` may be null, to prevent NullPointerExceptions.
